# openmetadata_pipeline Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata pipeline by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_pipeline" "daily_orders" {
  fully_qualified_name = "orchestrator.daily_orders"
}

output "daily_orders_task_names" {
  value = [for task in data.openmetadata_pipeline.daily_orders.tasks : task.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Pipeline fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Pipeline UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `concurrency` (Number) Maximum number of parallel task runs.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Pipeline name.
- `pipeline_location` (String) Location of the pipeline definition.
- `schedule_interval` (String) Cron expression that schedules the pipeline.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent pipeline service.
- `source_url` (String) Link to the pipeline definition in the orchestrator.
- `start_date` (Number) Pipeline start time as epoch milliseconds.
- `state` (String) Scheduling state, either Active or Inactive.
- `tasks` (Attributes List) Tasks that make up the pipeline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the task.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable task name.
- `downstream_tasks` (List of String) Names of tasks that run after this one.
- `end_date` (String) Task end time reported by the orchestrator.
- `name` (String) Task name.
- `source_url` (String) Link to the task definition in the orchestrator.
- `start_date` (String) Task start time reported by the orchestrator.
- `task_sql` (String) SQL statement executed by the task.
- `task_type` (String) Task type reported by the orchestrator.
